sources.label: DeepSeek V4 preview note
sources.excerpt: deepseek-chat & deepseek-reasoner will be fully retired and inaccessible after Jul 24th, 2026, 15:59 (UTC Time).

sources.label: DeepSeek API changelog
sources.excerpt: The two legacy API model names, deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner, will be discontinued in three months (2026-07-24). | During the current period, these two model names point to the non-thinking mode and thinking mode of deepseek-v4-flash, respectively.

sources.label: DeepSeek models and pricing
sources.excerpt: The legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted, but the corresponding models have been retired; their requests are served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 and billed at the Flash price.

sources.label: DeepSeek API changelog
sources.excerpt: The previous-generation models V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp have been retired; for compatibility, the model names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are temporarily routed to V4.1 Flash.
